visual_connections.description: Users connect to the static web portal served via CloudFront.
CloudFront distribution fetches static website assets from the hosting S3 bucket.
Sanofi enterprise identity provider federates user authentication with Cognito.
Cognito validates credentials for users accessing the S3-hosted web portal.
Web portal makes dynamic API requests through API Gateway.
API Gateway persists session traces, metadata, and user activity directly into DynamoDB.
Users request workspace provisioning from Service Catalog through the web interface.
Service Catalog launches a dedicated R Studio workspace upon user request.
Service Catalog launches a SageMaker notebook environment secure for the requesting user.
API Gateway routes NLP and translation requests to orchestrating Lambda functions.
Lambda invokes Translate API for automated document translation tasks.
Lambda invokes Comprehend Medical API to detect clinical entities.
